name: Progenitus
description: An enormous five-headed hydra that sleeps beneath the Valley of the Ancient and is worshipped by the Alaran elves.

description_citations.text: "Elf". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A keeper watches the valley where Progenitus sleeps.
timeline.quote: He watches over the valley where Progenitus sleeps

citation.text: Keeper of Progenitus (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elves believe Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.
timeline.quote: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

citation.text: Relic of Progenitus (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Progenitus, the Soul of the World, returns.
timeline.quote: The Soul of the World has returned.

citation.text: Progenitus (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Ancient Ziggurat reappears when Progenitus awakens.
timeline.quote: When Progenitus awakened, the temple emerged again.

citation.text: Ancient Ziggurat (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Following the Sundering of Alara, hydras are limited to the Shards of Naya and Jund; during the Conflux new hydras such as the Apocalypse Hydra come into conflict with other Shards.
timeline.quote: During the Conflux , new types of Hydras, like the Apocalypse Hydra , appeared that came into conflict with the other Shards, like Bant .

citation.text: "Hydra", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Progenitus begins to awaken in the Second Stirring.
timeline.quote: Fifteen years before the Conflux , Progenitus began to awaken, tearing the vegetation from its roots and ripping off huge sections of nearby mountains in an event later known as the Second Stirring.

citation.text: "Naya", section "The Second Stirring". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Conflux black and blue mana flood Naya, and Progenitus awakens.
timeline.quote: Naya is now flooded with all five colors and Progenitus has awoken, roving the lands for inscrutable purposes.

citation.text: "Naya", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Hydras are regarded as manifestations of Progenitus, Alara's world soul.
relations.quote: Hydras are regarded as the manifestations of the "soul of the world" of Alara , the behemoth Progenitus .

citation.text: "Hydra", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Elves worship gargantuans as signs of Progenitus.
relations.quote: The elves worship the gargantuans of the plane, believing that the behemoths' actions are signs from Progenitus

citation.text: "Naya", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
